AfterSideTurnStart.issue: The slot is right -- Hook.AfterSideTurnStart (CombatManager.cs:522) and the sim's on_player_turn_started (player.py:186) are both post-draw, which matters because Hellraiser-style auto-plays that fire DURING the draw (CardPileCmd.Draw at :673) must NOT see this Vigor, and on both sides they do not. The amount is right too (base.Amount, PrepTimePower.cs:22 vs powers.py:3695) and neither side ever removes the power, so it grants Vigor every turn for the rest of the combat. The gap is the phase collapse: PHASE COLLAPSE. The sim's on_player_turn_started (player.py:186) is a single slot serving THREE distinct C# phases that the game runs in a fixed order: Hook.AfterPlayerTurnStart (CombatManager.cs:675, inside the SetupPlayerTurn task launched at :514), then Hook.AfterSideTurnStart (:522), then Hook.AfterAutoPrePlayPhaseEntered (:568 -> RunAutoPrePlayPhase, :613-619). Collapsing them makes the relative order of this power and every other turn-start power a function of hook-REGISTRATION order, i.e. of which card the player happened to play first. Same shape as hook_dispatch's G3 (the Early/Late phase passes do not exist) one level up, and the AutoPrePlay/AutoPostPlay half of it is turn_structure's G8; neither is re-verdicted here per binding rule 3, but see this record's Mayhem guard for the executed consequence.

guards.what: Registration-order contention with Mayhem in the collapsed slot
guards.issue: LIVE, and it widens turn_structure's G8. MayhemPower is C#'s third ported AfterAutoPrePlayPhaseEntered implementer (MayhemPower.cs, applied by the ported Colorless power card Mayhem -- cards/colorless_powers.py:157-174) and G8 does not name it: G8 calls its AutoPrePlay half DORMANT on the grounds that 'the two ported users' effects (play cards / auto-play one Skill) do not read any other turn-start listener's output', naming only Whispering Earring and the Imbued enchantment. Mayhem does read another turn-start listener's output, and the pair is executed below. In the game Mayhem's auto-plays run at CombatManager.cs:568, strictly AFTER Hook.AfterSideTurnStart (:522) and after SetupPlayerTurn's Hook.AfterPlayerTurnStart (:675); in the sim MayhemPower.on_player_turn_started (powers.py:3572-3583) sits in the same dispatch as this power, so the order is registration order. EXECUTED with PrepTimePower 3 + MayhemPower 1 and one Strike on top of the draw pile: applying Prep Time FIRST makes the Mayhem-auto-played Strike deal 9 (6 + Vigor 3, Vigor consumed); applying Mayhem first makes it deal 6 and leaves Vigor(3) unspent. The game always deals 9. Both cards are ported Colorless power cards, so a single run can hold both -- binding rule 6 satisfied on both halves.
